propositions: event_append.py exceeds 500 LOC target (794 LOC as measured) and risks breaking the 800 LOC hard cap in CI
Four independent concerns in event_append.py (pre-lock preparation, bounded git verbs, commit-failure recovery, locked write orchestration) should be separated into distinct modules
Pre-lock event preparation (concern A) and bounded git verbs (concern B) should be extracted as leaf modules without importing event_append or each other
Commit-failure self-heal (concern C) must remain coupled with locked write orchestration (concern D) because recovery re-issues git verbs through a shared module-global monkeypatch seam
All external bindings must be re-exported from event_append to preserve consumer imports and monkeypatch visibility without test or consumer code changes
